answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 41397 Country: India Title: My first question is I receive the Quran ayat through SMS and I delete this SMS Question: My first question is I receive the Quran ayat through SMS and I delete this SMS. Can we delete the Quran ayat SMS? Please reply. My second question is that can I read the holy Quran ayat when I am napak? Answer ID: 41397 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1317/881/H=1433) If it is finished automatically it is better, however if you remove it then it is also allowable but if you keep it then it is also right.
